summary: Order placement is failing or stalling because broker-gateway began returning HTTP 503 at about 10:00 UTC. Its err_rate rose from 0.005 at 09:55 to 0.075 at 10:00 and then stayed near 0.105. Its /orders/status endpoint slowed progressively, from 331ms to about 696ms. order-router, orchestrator and web-app errors are all downstream effects of those broker-gateway 503s. The order-router deploy at 09:50 ('log level tweak') is a candidate trigger, but broker-gateway was still healthy at 09:55, so I do not think it is the cause. I could not find why broker-gateway is failing, whether the cause is internal or the upstream broker, because I did not look at its ERROR logs or its own dependencies.

hypotheses.statement: broker-gateway degraded at about 10:00 (slow /orders/status, then HTTP 503), possibly because of its upstream broker. This is the origin of the order failures, and order-router, orchestrator and web-app errors are consequences. The underlying mechanism is not yet identified.
hypotheses.label: high

unresolved: Why broker-gateway started returning 503 and why /orders/status slowed (internal fault or upstream broker); broker-gateway ERROR logs and its upstream dependencies were not examined.
Whether the order-router 00455 deploy had any effect; it is unlikely given e1, but not directly ruled out.
Error logs were truncated at 50 of 74 matches, so error volume after 10:16 was not reviewed.
Other services such as orchestrator and queues were not checked for independent problems.

actions.text: Inspect broker-gateway ERROR logs and upstream broker connectivity, status and quota from 09:55 to 10:05. Check for a broker outage or throttling, and for a change on the broker side.
actions.rationale: broker-gateway is the earliest deviating component, and its callers are failing on its 503s.

actions.text: Mitigate customer impact: add backoff or retry limits and show order status clearly to customers, so retries do not add load to broker-gateway.
actions.rationale: Customers are retrying, which can amplify load on a degraded broker-gateway.

actions.text: Keep the order-router rollback ready but do not execute it unless broker-gateway checks point to order-router. Verify that 00455 changed nothing beyond log level.
actions.rationale: The deploy is a weak candidate: broker-gateway was healthy after it and the change is described as cosmetic.
